about: The Workbench icons of the xu4 drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is xu4's own 64x64 icon (icons/u4.png, GPL 2 with xu4). xu4-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, xu4.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's xu4.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-xu4, COPYING.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the icon of every subdrawer (conf, graphics, sound, User).
